changes.before: Excludes data centers beginning operations on or after 2026-08-01 from the Business Equipment Tax Exemption and Dirigo Business Incentives Program. Defines "data center" in Title 36 and requires the Department of Economic and Community Development to study financial incentives that data centers may benefit from, with report due 2026-11-04.
